items: Framework controls not exercised by a dispatched agent: 10 (listed in the framework assessment as « Not tested by this campaign »).
Assets outside the target and the tested scope are not covered.
Penalty unit: one asset and one weakness class. Severity weights: critical 30, high 15, medium 5, low 2, informational 0. Proof factors: exploited 1, confirmed 0.8, to confirm 0.5.
Each further distinct weakness in a unit adds 10 % (at most 30 %); each further asset of a class adds 25 % of its penalty (at most 50 %).
Rating = 100 minus the penalty sum, bounded 0 to 100, then the caps by worst evidence (exploited critical ≤ 39; confirmed critical ≤ 49; exploited high ≤ 59) and 69 for a limited test.
